```{r}

mm <- read.csv("https://stats.idre.ucla.edu/stat/data/mmreg.csv")
colnames(mm) <- c("Control", "Concept", "Motivation", "Read", "Write", "Math", 
                  "Science", "Sex")
summary(mm)

colnames(mm) <- c("Locus", "Autoconcepto", "Motivacion", "Lectura", "Escritura", "Matematicas", 
                  "Ciencias", "Sexo")
summary(mm)


mm%>%mutate(Sexo=as.factor(Sexo))%>%ggplot(aes(Locus,fill=Sexo))+geom_histogram()+facet_wrap(~Sexo)+guides(fill=FALSE)




ggplot(mm,aes(Locus),fill=Sex)+geom_histogram()



```
